what:
aide-memory's product model — three axes (clarified 2026-04-20, REVISED 2026-04-21 to allow future pro tier):

**Axis 1: Paid tier / feature gating = NOT IN THIS VERSION; RESERVED FOR FUTURE.**
THIS version (and the 0.x series) is FREE with all features available to everyone. No feature gating by license, no pro-vs-free distinction at runtime, no paywall in current code. HOWEVER, future versions MAY introduce pro features requiring payment — the license explicitly reserves this right. The free-tier-only framing of the CURRENT version should NOT be extended to "free forever across all versions" in marketing copy. Acceptable framings: "Free for this version", "All features free in the current release", "Built for the open community (this release is free)". AVOID: "always free", "free forever", "no paid tier ever".

**Axis 2: Settings configurability = YES (fully public).**
Every setting in defaults.json is user-configurable via `aide-memory config`. No `public: true/false` metadata checks, no `pro: true/false` gates in the code. Settings are transparent and adjustable. (Future pro features, if added, would likely be in separate features not currently-public settings.)

**Axis 3: Source code visibility = NO (proprietary, closed-source) — STRONGEST commitment.**
Source lives in private dev repo (`ahmedmmeky/aide-v0`). Public repo (`aide-memory/aide-memory`) only has curated README + LICENSE + release workflow + issue templates + binary release assets. Source is NOT open and NOT intended to become open. Binary/minified distribution extends this protection. LICENSE explicitly prohibits reverse-engineering, decompilation, derivative works, redistribution, and competing-product development. User cannot HAVE the code or REUSE the code in either the current free version or any future pro version.

**Positioning for external content:**
- ✓ "Free" (for this version) — accurate (Axis 1 current)
- ✓ "All features, no gates" (for this version) — accurate (Axis 1 + Axis 2 current)
- ✓ "Private, in your repo, not in cloud" — accurate (memories are local/git-scoped)
- ✓ "Pro features coming" — acceptable for forward-looking copy
- ❌ "Open source" — WRONG (Axis 3)
- ❌ "Always free" / "Free forever" — WRONG (Axis 1 future)
- ❌ "Pro features unlocked" (in current version) — WRONG (no pro exists yet)

Product model is closer to "free now, freemium later" than Discord/Zoom's "free forever + all features + closed source". License reserves the right to add paid features in future versions while keeping the current version free under its current terms.

Mental check before writing any marketing copy: walk through all three axes + temporal dimension (current version vs future). [docs/**]
why: User revised the product model 2026-04-21: current version stays free (no pro tier in code today), but future versions may have paid features. Previous "always free" framing is wrong-forward. Axis 3 (source closed) is unchanged and strongest. Drafted LICENSE reflects this with Section 5 explicitly reserving future pro versions.
